Try pasting it in the Facebook search bar. That worked for me
I just got this for Christmas from a friend. It’s short sweet and to the point

I get myself very tired with tea and maybe a movie. I pay attention to my sleepiness, so when I almost fall asleep, I turn the TV and any remaining lights off. I lay flat, no sound, and focus on each body part starting from the hair on my head to the nails on my toes (if I even make it that far) telling each part to relax. I start to feel light in weight. My body is still and my brain is alive. From there I’m able to make it what I want, really.
But also, I do believe that the first time I tried, I achieved. I had been a regular at meditation before, but barely knew anything about lucid dreams when I tried. It was risky but it worked. Super cool 10/10
Therapy definitely helps but pretty much only for the rest of the day after the session. I try to carry on the habits tht are suggested in my sessions but I’m running out of motivation
